item.title: If you won’t wear headphones, you could get booted from your flight: United Airlines
item.description: United updated its 'contract of carriage' to state that 'passengers who fail to use headphones while listening to audio or video content' can be refused transport

item.title: Britney Spears detained on suspicion of driving while intoxicated
item.description: Sheriff records showed the 44-year-old singer had been released at 6:07 AM local time and a court appearance had been set for May 4

item.title: Donald Trump replaces Kristi Noem as Homeland Security chief after rocky tenure
item.description: The move would become effective on March 31. Trump said that Noem would take a role as a special envoy for the Western Hemisphere

item.title: Don Cherry receives Order of Canada nomination from MP Andrew Lawton
item.description: The 92-year-old sports commentator was named to the Order of Ontario just this month

item.title: Violent crime, hate crimes and thefts remain high in Canada, finds think tank’s justice report card
item.description: Police-reported hate crimes increased an alarming 85 per cent between 2020 and 2024

item.title: Iran intensifies attacks across Gulf as Israel bombards Tehran
item.description: Iran said it attacked U.S. forces in Iraq and Kuwait, as well as targets in U.A.E., Bahrain and Qatar, and struck an oil tanker in the Persian Gulf

item.title: Trump’s new tariffs face legal challenge by group of states
item.description: Attorneys general from New York and Oregon said a group of states will file a lawsuit over Trump’s 10 per cent tax on imports that took effect Feb. 24

item.title: Canada’s top general weighing military options to support Gulf states in Iran conflict
item.description: Defence Staff General Jennie Carignan said that any Canadian role would have to be adjusted to the threats on the ground

item.title: Seven countries to boycott Paralympics opening ceremony over Russia athletes
item.description: Organizers are allowing six Russians and four athletes from Belarus to take part in the Games under their national flags

item.title: After years of feuding with Europe, Trump now seeks its help with Iran war
item.description: Trump’s frustration reflects a simple reality: Europe, though still heavily dependent on the U.S. through institutions like NATO, retains leverage
